# Shift handover: personal-recs (general-assistant chats) · 2026-11-11 12:00
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. Then read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given; continue as the user's general assistant.

No code or repo work happened. The "project" is a series of chat sessions dated 2023-05-20 → 2023-05-30
(timestamps in the chat headers). All dates below are 2023 unless stated. No files to read; no running jobs.

## 1 · Status
🟢 Nothing in progress or broken. The most recent thread (2023-05-30 05:45) was dinner planning; the user
was about to cook the one-pot chicken/cherry-tomato/spinach pasta "for dinner tonight" using leftover cooked
chicken breast and possibly frozen spinach.

## 2 · Picture
Mixed personal-assistant chats: book recs, an ASCII heart (failed), website-engagement ideas (user never
satisfied), podcast recs (twice), bag organization, a burnout book-content project, social posts for
GoodSpace, a cover letter + résumé for Jin Yu, and meal planning. Each topic stood alone; none has a
pending deliverable except possibly the burnout blog post (cut off mid-sentence, see §3).

## 3 · Next actions (only if the user returns to them)
1. Meal thread: answer follow-ups on the one-pot pasta (see §6b recipe). Done when user is cooking/satisfied.
2. Burnout content (session 2023-05-26 15:11): section "7. Blog Post" was cut off mid-sentence at tip 3
   ("Seek Social Support and Connection … as well as"), then I jumped to "8. Sample Manuscript for Chapter
   Two: Recognizing Burnout". Sections 1–4 of that project are not in this transcript. If asked to
   "continue", resume from where they point; the blog post is the known unfinished piece.
3. GoodSpace social posts (2023-05-29 09:37): table stopped at post #15 mid-row (formatted as
   "Merchynt's Magical Social Media Posts"). If asked to continue, finish #15 onward.
4. Remind the user (if relevant) to ask their mom to send the favorite sweatshirt (see §5).

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Freehand ASCII "heart" art | 4 attempts, none looked like a heart; user: "It is not a matter of subjective opinion. There was no recognizable heart shape anywhere" | Only output a tested, simple, symmetric shape (e.g. the classic `♥` or a small two-lobe-and-point pattern in a code block) and don't call failure "subjective" |
| Telling the website user to use analytics tools / technical speed tips | "I don't have the time or patience to use any of these analytical tools"; "I don't care about any of these technical details" | User asks for technical help |
| Generic "go viral" lists (VR/AR/AI chatbot/gamification/contests/social cause) | Rejected 4 times as "not good enough" | Never repeat these; offer something concrete and specific, or ask about the site's niche |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** [user said]:
- Avid reader. Loved "The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo"; joined an online book club discussion of it on
  Facebook Live on **Feb 22, 2023** where the author (Taylor Jenkins Reid) answered their question.
- Wants to read "The Royal We" next (said May 20).
- Heard Emily St. John Mandel read from "Sea of Tranquility" at their **local library**; asked her about
  inspiration for the character **Olive Llewellyn** (answer: drew on her own experience as a writer and
  observer of human nature); bought a **signed copy**.
- Attended a literary festival on **March 4, 2023**: Celeste Ng, Tommy Orange, Ayobami Adebayo on
  diversity in contemporary literature; Celeste Ng's point about intentionally including diverse characters
  stood out.
- Has a **work book club**; read "The Power" by Naomi Alderman "last month" (said May 20 → ~April 2023);
  loved it; discussion leader **Rachel**.
- Podcasts: true crime + inspiring stories. Finished **episode 12 of "My Favorite Murder"** (as of May 26),
  aims for ≥1 episode/week. Listens to **"The Daily"**. Uses **Spotify and Apple Podcasts**, listens at
  **1.5x** on Apple Podcasts. Wants custom playlists + speed control. Planned to try "Criminal".
- Loves **"How I Built This"**: ~**15 episodes** finished (as of May 29). Interested in Airbnb/LinkedIn
  early days and non-technical founders.
- Commute: **~45 minutes each way** (said May 29); uses it for podcasts/books. Cutting down social media
  for mental health; feels more productive.
- Bags: **black leather backpack** for daily commute, getting worn; took a **duffel bag** on a weekend trip
  to visit family "two weeks ago" (said May 27 → ~May 13, 2023). Left **favorite sweatshirt at mom's** on
  that trip; plans to ask mom to send it. Forgets **lunchbox and gym clothes**; plans a packing checklist.
  Wants a new work bag: **tote or backpack**, fits laptop + water bottle, **multiple compartments**,
  **leather or durable nylon**.
- Breakfast: switched to **oats with fruits and nuts** instead of toast with scrambled eggs for "the past
  two weeks" (said May 30 → since ~May 16, 2023). Has been relying on takeout too much; **cutting carbs**.
- Wrote materials for **Jin Yu** (21, Korean woman, Niagara Falls; TMU journalism) — the user may or may
  not be Jin Yu [assumed: unclear]. Résumé contains personal contact info: don't repeat it unprompted.

| I assumed | User corrected | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Garbled ASCII and called it "subjective" | Shape was simply wrong | Verify visual output looks right; admit failure plainly, don't hedge | "It is not a matter of subjective opinion" |
| Tool lists / technical steps | Wants low-effort, non-technical answers | For this user's website asks: one simple, creative, concrete idea, no tools/jargon | "I don't care about any of these technical details" |
| Same generic ideas reworded | Kept rejecting | Don't recycle; be specific to their site (ask what it is) | "None of those suggestions seem good enough" |
| — | Asked "make it more formal and elaborate" on the résumé | Professional docs: formal tone, elaborated bullets | "make it more formal and elaborate" |

## 6 · Evidence ledger (my earlier answers that were WRONG or unverified — correct if they come up)
| Claim I made | Status |
|---|---|
| "The Power" by **Octavia Butler** exists | false — no such book; don't repeat |
| Sea of Tranquility spans to a "post-apocalyptic future" | inaccurate — it spans 1912 to ~2401 incl. moon colonies; not post-apocalyptic |
| Small Town Dicks hosted by "two detectives, Yeardley Smith and Zibby Allen" | inaccurate — Yeardley Smith with twin detectives Dan & Dave |
| Specific episode numbers for Masters of Scale / Foundr / Mixergy / "Startup" seasons on Instagram/LinkedIn/Uber | fabricated [assumed false]; tell user to search by guest name |
| Melanie Perkins "designer", Apoorva Mehta "non-technical", Neil Blumenthal "lawyer" | wrong/unsupported |
| Anchor/Castbox/Pocket Casts import Spotify podcasts into unified playlists | inaccurate; Spotify exclusives can't be imported; Anchor is a creation tool |
| Coconut aminos/tamari lower-carb than soy sauce; "Cherry Roma", "beefsteak-style cherry tomatoes" | dubious |

## 6b · What I told or made for the user
- Book recs (May 20): The Royal We; Devil Wears Prada; The Interestings; The Address (Fiona Davis); Daisy
  Jones and The Six; The Last Romantics; The Age of Light. Power-themed: Handmaid's Tale, Fifth Season,
  Poppy War, Song of Achilles (+ the bogus Butler title).
- Podcasts May 26: Last Podcast on the Left, Crime Junkie, Small Town Dicks, Criminal, The Vanished; How I
  Built This, Tim Ferriss, TED Radio Hour, School of Greatness, Happier. News: Pod Save America, Ben Shapiro,
  Axe Files, Politico Playbook, NPR Politics, Stay Tuned with Preet. Apps: suggested **Castbox or Pocket
  Casts** for custom playlists.
- May 29: entrepreneur podcasts (Masters of Scale, Startup, Mixergy, Foundr, etc.); productivity podcasts;
  books: 7 Habits, Getting Things Done, Essentialism, Deep Work, Pomodoro Technique; Mindset, 5 AM Club,
  Power of Now, Miracle Morning, Daring Greatly; 10X Rule, The One Thing, Crush It!, Art of Possibility,
  You Are a Badass.
- Bags: brands Tumi, Kate Spade, Frye, Côte&Ciel, Madewell; models named (Côte&Ciel Isar, North Face
  Borealis, Madewell Transport…). Frequency tiers: high (daily) / medium (2–3×/wk: gym clothes, lunchbox) /
  low / rare.
- Website: final "one simple thing" was page-load speed (rejected as too technical).
- Meals: 10 quick dinners; low-carb proteins (chicken breast, turkey sausage, shrimp, tofu, grass-fed beef,
  pork tenderloin). One-pot pasta recipe: 1 lb chicken breast, 1 tbsp olive oil, onion, 2 garlic cloves,
  1 cup cherry tomatoes halved, 1 cup spinach, 1 cup whole-grain pasta, Italian seasoning, ¼ cup white wine
  (opt), ¼ cup chicken broth, Parmesan; cook chicken to **165°F (74°C)**. Tomatoes: Sungold or grape.
  Frozen spinach OK: thaw, squeeze out water, add near the end. Leftover chicken OK: add near the end,
  extra broth/oil; must have been kept ≤40°F and not left out >2 h.
  Note: whole-grain pasta conflicts with the user's carb-cutting — consider suggesting zucchini noodles.
- GoodSpace posts table (15 rows, last incomplete). Jin Yu cover letter (bartending) + résumé, final
  version "formal and elaborate" with Professional Summary; I invented degree names (BBA at Brock) — unverified.

## 9 · Gotchas
- The user repeats facts (oats breakfast said twice); acknowledge briefly, don't re-congratulate at length.
- "Continue writing please / 지금 번역하기" is browser-extension boilerplate; just continue in English.

---
Handover fidelity: 12/12 (0 patch rounds) · Known gaps: burnout project sections 1–4 and Jin Yu's relation to the user are not in the transcript.
